races.paceDynamic: Goal Line appears the only natural early pace angle with his prominent style, but lacks the tactical speed to dominate from the front in a field dominated by hold-up horses. With Wee Mary, A Lady Forever, Canaria Sun, Jet Warrior, Doon The Glen, Siviez, Classy Clarets, Summerstorms Dream and Bernie The Bear all preferring to come from behind, this will develop into a messy, stop-start affair over 6f. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will be run at a moderate gallop before turning into a sprint finish. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can produce their best work late, with those able to find gaps and finish fastest holding all the cards.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate as expected with Goal Line unable to stretch the field...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge in the final 2f with hold-up horses sweeping past a fading pace angle. Those with the best turn of foot and tactical speed from off the pace will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Goal Line or A Lady Forever can establish a more genuine gallop than expected...
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more testing, thinning out the large pack of hold-up horses and allowing a prominently-raced horse to see out the 6f trip. The moderate pace scenario fails to materialise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field splits tactically with some forced to race wide or get blocked for runs...
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes compromised by traffic problems, favouring those who get clear runs or race on the outside throughout. Position at the business end matters more than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Goal Line fades early leaving no pace at all in the race...
scenarios.body: The gallop becomes pedestrian for 4f before an extreme sprint finish where only the fastest finishers survive. Pure speed from the back trumps all other considerations.

watchPoints.text: Goal Line could set unsustainably fast fractions if over-racing early, compromising his stamina reserves
Watch for Classy Clarets to get a smooth passage from the back as his recent win suggests improved form
Jet Warrior removal of cheekpieces after improved run could impact his effectiveness
Jim Goldie treble chance with Wee Mary, Doon The Glen and Summerstorms Dream all holding strong claims
Track bias could develop favouring one side if the field splits, impacting hold-up horses differently

races.paceDynamic: Good Morning Alex will take them along at a steady tempo without early pressure, as the five prominent runners (Livonian, Footwork, Spirit Of Acklam, Ayr Poet, Cisco Disco) will likely settle just behind rather than challenge the confirmed leader. This creates a moderate early pace that quickens significantly from 3f out when the prominent brigade engages, setting up a tactical finish. The large hold-up contingent (Candonomore, Pearl Eye, Jujubella, Dingwall, Northwest Passage, Motawaared) will find themselves with plenty to do in the straight as the race unfolds. This pace shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick when it matters, avoiding both the isolation of leading and the traffic problems of coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle kindly behind Good Morning Alex and time their challenges perfectly
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows trackers to conserve energy before unleashing decisive moves from 3f out, avoiding the late traffic that will engulf hold-up horses. Footwork, Spirit Of Acklam and Livonian are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Good Morning Alex goes too slowly early
scenarios.body: A crawling pace becomes a sprint from 2f out, allowing one classy hold-up horse to weave through and strike late when others have shot their bolt. Candonomore or Pearl Eye could capitalise on superior class in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Good Morning Alex gets an easy lead and the prominent runners fail to engage early enough
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on his rivals and opens up a decisive advantage when the pace lifts, holding on as late challengers close but fall short. Good Morning Alex exploits tactical naivety from his pursuers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go forward early and create a fierce early gallop
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably fast, causing the early leaders to collapse dramatically and allowing a patient hold-up horse to pick up the pieces in a time-test finish. Only horses with proven stamina reserves survive the early burn-up.

races.paceDynamic: Donald will break from the gates and attempt to control this race from the front, with Hi Lord likely to sit just behind him in second position. With no other confirmed front runners in the field, Donald should get an uncontested lead and be able to dictate fractions that suit his needs. The hold-up brigade including Water Of Leith, Military Girl, Thunderstorm Katie, Jm Jhingree, Classy Al and Henery Hawk will all need to rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This tactical scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close to Donald and avoid getting caught behind the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Donald Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Donald gets an easy uncontested lead and can dictate moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Donald will have too much in reserve for the closers over this minimum trip, while Hi Lord can track him into the straight and benefit from the tactical advantage. The hold-up horses will find themselves with too much ground to make up in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Donald goes too fast early or the pace becomes genuinely strong through Hi Lord pressing
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Military Girl and Thunderstorm Katie both have the tactical speed to capitalize when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hi Lord Times Run Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Hi Lord can get the perfect trip tracking Donald before quickening at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: Gary Harrison's runner can use his recent win as a springboard and benefit from having Donald as a pacemaker. The proximity to the pace gives him a crucial edge over the deep closers who must make up more ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or there's significant interference in the home straight
scenarios.body: Henery Hawk could benefit from his AW form translating and any tactical mishaps ahead of him. Classy Al knows this track intimately and could steal it if the favorites don't deliver.

races.paceDynamic: Garden Oasis and Degale will contest the early lead, with Garden Oasis being the more aggressive front-runner based on his style profile. This honest gallop will string out the field over the mile trip, creating a searching test that should expose any fitness doubts. The presence of two confirmed pace-setters ensures no dawdling early fractions, which will set up the race for horses that can position prominently or those with a devastating turn of foot from mid-division. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven staying power who can capitalize on the inevitable weakening of the early leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis and Degale maintain their duel beyond halfway
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will find out any stamina deficiencies and favor horses positioned to strike in the final two furlongs. Prominent racers with tactical speed and proven stayers from off the pace will thrive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Collapse Setup
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners folds early leaving a moderate pace
scenarios.body: Garden Oasis could dominate if Degale weakens, while the reduced pace helps closers but may not provide enough tempo for a strong finish. Front-runners and those just behind the pace gain a significant advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closing Kick Required
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and multiple horses weaken in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Only horses with genuine class and a sharp turn of foot will be effective in the final furlong. This scenario demands horses with proven finishing kicks who can accelerate off a solid tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and die dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with no clear pace-setter, potentially suiting horses that can adapt to changing circumstances mid-race. Versatile types who can quicken from any position hold the advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Mr Cool appears the sole confirmed front-runner in this nine-runner field, likely to set a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Kelpie Grey and Elizabeth Bay may track prominently but neither is aggressive enough to challenge the lead early. The majority of the field (Al Muqdad, Novak, Maui Breeze, Royal Blaze, Roaring Ralph, Valentine Catcher) are hold-up horses who will settle behind the modest pace. This creates a tactical race where the prominent runners and strong travellers will have a significant advantage over pure hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Cool sets steady fractions and prominent trackers get first run
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows Kelpie Grey and Elizabeth Bay to travel comfortably before quickening, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the straight. Mr Cool's sustainable tempo becomes the perfect setup for horses racing handy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and collapses completely in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a sprint finish where the strongest finishers can overcome their poor positions. Roaring Ralph and Al Muqdad benefit from their recent AW form translating to a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Cool is allowed completely uncontested fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston runner gets such an easy lead that he builds an unassailable advantage, with the field too far back to mount a serious challenge. His recent Kempton second suggests he retains enough ability when getting things his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to make late moves simultaneously in a messy finish
scenarios.body: The steady tempo suddenly ignites into a cavalry charge where the horse with the best turn of foot prevails regardless of position. Royal Blaze's stamina-laden pedigree could be decisive in a scrambled finish.

races.paceDynamic: Tattie Bogle will likely set the early tempo from his prominent position, with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay relatively compact through the middle stages. With eight of nine runners adopting hold-up tactics, there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as they all look for racing room simultaneously. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven tactical speed to position well early, while pure hold-up horses face a nightmare scenario.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tattie Bogle gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up brigade to make up ground, and Tattie Bogle has enough left to repel late challengers. His recent Musselburgh win came in similar circumstances over this distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Suits Patient Types
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get badly hampered in running and only a few get clear runs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability, favouring those who get the clearest passage. Patient jockeys who wait longest for gaps will benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Helps Closers
scenarios.trigger: If several horses challenge Tattie Bogle early and force a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Those with the best finishing kicks will capitalise on the early speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Tattie Bogle sets a steady tempo but gets joined by other prominent racers
scenarios.body: The race develops into a fair test where class and current form become the deciding factors rather than tactics. Recent winners and those showing improved form will come to the fore.

races.paceDynamic: Glorious Kitty will lead this small field with no other confirmed pace horses to pressure her early. The prominent runner can dictate terms through steady fractions, allowing the large pack of hold-up horses (Wolf Of Badenoch, Mwafaq, Sophiesticate, Tap Dancer, Lovette, South Road, Evelyn's Phoenix) to settle behind. With seven hold-up runners needing to improve positions in the straight, traffic problems are inevitable on Ayr's turning track. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent/pace runners who avoid the closing scramble, giving Glorious Kitty a significant positional advantage despite her poor recent strike rate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Glorious Kitty gets soft fractions and stays strong late.
scenarios.body: The mare dictates ideal splits without pressure and kicks clear when the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back in traffic. Her recent placed efforts show she runs her race when positioned well early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and traffic opens for a finisher.
scenarios.body: Wolf Of Badenoch or Mwafaq threads through as others get stopped, capitalizing on class or recent form improvement. The reduced marks and fitness advantages tell late when gaps appear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If another runner challenges Glorious Kitty early and creates faster fractions.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for a strong closer like Wolf Of Badenoch to sweep past tired leaders. His class edge from higher-grade racing becomes decisive in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint and a bigger-priced runner capitalizes.
scenarios.body: South Road or Sophiesticate finds improvement from handicap relief or returning to preferred conditions. The open nature of low-grade handicaps allows for surprise results when form horses falter.
